account.name: Your name
account.guessed: These settings are a best guess. Check them if connecting fails.
account.oauthHint: {{provider}} asks you to sign in on their website. Your password never passes through UwUMail.
account.appPasswordHint: Using two-factor authentication? Many providers need an app password here.
account.errorAuth: The server rejected the username or password.
account.errorConnection: Couldn't connect to the server. Check the address and your internet connection.
account.errorInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
account.usePasswordInstead: Sign in with a password instead
account.signInAsHint: Only for shared mailboxes: the address you sign in with at Microsoft. Leave empty when this is your own mailbox.
account.errorImapDisabled: IMAP is switched off for this mailbox. Only an administrator can change it, in Exchange Online PowerShell: Set-CASMailbox -Identity ADDRESS -ImapEnabled $true
account.errorSmtpDisabled: This mailbox may not send over SMTP. An administrator can allow it with: Set-CASMailbox -Identity ADDRESS -SmtpClientAuthenticationDisabled $false — with security defaults on in Entra, it has to be allowed there as well.
account.errorAdminConsent: Your organisation allows apps only after an administrator agrees.
account.adminConsentBody: Microsoft often lets company mailboxes in only once IT has allowed UwUMail. Send this link to your administrators — after that, signing in works for everyone in the company.
account.errorOauthDemo: Sign-in with {{provider}} needs the desktop app.
account.errorOauthMissing: This build of UwUMail carries no credentials for signing in with {{provider}}. They can only be set when the app is built.
account.protocolJmapHint: Your server speaks JMAP: faster, lighter on data, and new mail arrives instantly.
account.protocolImapHint: The classic way. You can switch to JMAP later in the settings.
account.jmapUrlHint: Usually https://your-server/.well-known/jmap. Leave empty for IMAP only.
account.fastmailTokenHint: Fastmail needs an API token here: Settings › Privacy & Security › Manage API tokens, with access to mail and sending.
account.cleartextBody: Your password and mail travel readable through the network. Only use this for a server in your own network.
account.accountNameHint: What the mailbox is called in UwUMail. Only you see it.
account.serverViaMx: Found through your domain’s MX record. Check that this really is your mail server before you sign in.
account.uwumailLoginHint: You sign in to your UwUMail server in the browser. It makes an app password just for this device – your password never passes through the app.
account.appPasswordNameHint: This is how the device shows up under Security in your UwUMail account, where you can sign it out any time.
account.uwumailWaiting: Waiting for the sign-in in your browser

settings.title: Settings
settings.listDensityDesc: Compact fits more mail on screen, with a small picture and two lines.
settings.contrastDesc: High makes text and outlines stronger. With System, UwUMail follows your operating system.
settings.motionDesc: With System, UwUMail follows the reduced motion setting of your operating system.
settings.nyuAnimationsDesc: Short scenes when you send, archive or open mail, and while the assistant thinks, for every mailbox. Reduced shows them as still pictures, as reduced motion does.
settings.conversationsDesc: Replies appear together with the message they answer.
settings.remoteImagesDesc: Remote images can tell senders when and where you opened a message.
settings.trustedSendersDesc: A company like @shop.example covers all of its addresses, including news@ or noreply@.
settings.trustedSendersEmpty: Nobody yet. You add senders right in the image notice of a message.
settings.trustedSendersInactive: Only applies with “Ask every time”. Right now UwUMail loads all images.
settings.removeAccountConfirm: Remove {{email}} from UwUMail? Mail on the server isn't touched.
settings.license: Free software under the GNU GPL v3.0.
settings.mailAppearanceDesc: Automatic darkens simple mails and keeps elaborately designed newsletters light. Plain text always follows the app theme.
settings.darkImagesDesc: Light images in dark mails are recolored as well: white backgrounds turn dark, dark lettering turns light. Photos stay as they are.
settings.senderPicturesDesc: Shows people’s pictures and companies’ logos instead of initials. With an account on a UwUMail server, the server asks instead of this device; otherwise UwUMail asks a company’s website at most once a month, never per mail. Switched off, you still see your contacts’ photos and the pictures of people on your UwUMail server.
settings.detectEventsDesc: Dates like “Fri, Oct 17 at 7:30pm” or “Oct 6–9” are underlined and offered for your calendar, also from the text in pictures (read by your UwUMail server or this device's text recognition). This happens by rules, without any AI; the AI assistant only reads a mail when you ask it to.
settings.proxyDesc: Pictures in mail, sender pictures and one-click unsubscribes go through this proxy, e.g. your VPN's SOCKS5 proxy (socks5://…, http://…). For an account on a UwUMail server, that server fetches the pictures. Mail itself never takes the proxy. Leave empty for none.
settings.proxyInvalid: That is not a proxy address. It starts with socks5://, socks5h:// or http://.
settings.proxySaved: Pictures now go through the proxy
settings.protocolSwitchConfirm: Switch {{email}} to {{protocol}}? UwUMail downloads the mail again for that.
settings.runInBackground: Keep running in the notification area
settings.runInBackgroundDesc: Closing the window leaves UwUMail next to the clock, so new mail still arrives. Quit it from its icon there.
settings.updatesDesc: UwUMail downloads new versions quietly and installs them the next time it starts.

mac.defaultMailDesc: Mail links (mailto:) on your Mac open in the default mail app.
mac.isDefaultMail: UwUMail is your default mail app.
mac.madeDefaultMail: UwUMail now opens your mail links.
mac.loginItemDesc: UwUMail starts when you log in to your Mac, so new mail arrives right away.
mac.loginItemApproval: Waiting for your OK: allow UwUMail under System Settings → General → Login Items.

settings.channelBetaDesc: Beta gets new features earlier, and sometimes a rough edge.
settings.updateChecksDesc: At start and every six hours. Off: UwUMail only asks when you tap “Check for updates”.
settings.swipeDesc: What happens when you swipe a mail in the list.
settings.appLockDesc: Ask for fingerprint, face or PIN when UwUMail opens.
settings.appLockUnavailable: Set up a screen lock on your phone first.
settings.backgroundPush: Tell me about new mail right away
settings.backgroundPushDesc: UwUMail stays connected in the background. Android shows a quiet, lasting notification for that, which you can hide.
settings.unifiedPushDesc: Your UnifiedPush app delivers new mail for JMAP mailboxes whose server supports it, so UwUMail doesn't have to stay connected for them. Other mailboxes keep their own connection.
settings.unifiedPushAll: All mailboxes get new mail through {{app}}. The lasting notification isn't needed anymore.
settings.unifiedPushPartly_one: {{count}} mailbox gets new mail through {{app}}. The others stay connected with the lasting notification.
settings.unifiedPushPartly_other: {{count}} mailboxes get new mail through {{app}}. The others stay connected with the lasting notification.
settings.unifiedPushNone: None of your mailboxes can use it yet. That needs a JMAP server with Web Push, such as UwUMail Server 0.14 or newer.
settings.unifiedPushFailed: Some mailboxes couldn't be set up. They stay connected with the lasting notification.
settings.unifiedPushGone: Your push app is gone, so UwUMail stays connected itself again.
settings.offlineDaysDesc: Newer mail is stored completely on the phone and can be read and searched offline. Older mail only with sender, subject and preview; its content loads when you open it.
settings.undoSendDesc: How long you can still take a sent mail back. It goes out even if you close the window meanwhile.
settings.sendersDesc: The addresses you can write from. JMAP mailboxes bring more addresses from the server; otherwise add your aliases here. Replies go out from the address the mail was sent to.
settings.signaturesEmpty: There's no signature for this address yet.
settings.signatureImageFailed: The picture couldn't be added. Use a PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP under 8 MB.
settings.signatureChangedElsewhere: The signatures were changed elsewhere in the meantime. They have been reloaded; please check them and save again.
settings.blockedSendersDesc: New mail from these senders goes to the spam folder. For accounts on a UwUMail server, the server sorts it, even while the app is closed. Block someone from “More” in a mail.
settings.linkConfirmDesc: Shows where a link from a mail goes first. Disguised links always ask.
settings.linkDomainsDesc: Links to these sites open right away, unless they are disguised.
settings.linkDomainsEmpty: None yet. You add sites right when you open a link.
settings.linkDomainsInactive: Right now every link opens without asking.
settings.syncAccountDesc: Look, language, pictures, links and signatures follow your UwUMail account: in the app on every device and in the webmail. Layout, density, swipes, app lock and updates stay on this device. Turning off the question before links or the image blocker only applies on the device where you do it.
settings.syncNone: None of your accounts is on a UwUMail server that keeps settings. They stay on this device.
settings.syncOffline: {{email}} can’t be reached right now. Changes wait and go out once it’s back.
settings.syncRefused: The server doesn’t take {{count}} settings. They stay on this device.
settings.signatureLocalOnlyDesc: This signature stays on this device: it’s too big to sync (256 KB at most) or has pictures that only work here.
settings.fontDesc: For the whole app and for mails. Only on this device.
settings.senderFontsDesc: Many HTML mails are set in Times or another serif font. Mails without a font of their own always get yours.
settings.signaturesDomainsDesc: Pick a domain and write one signature for all your addresses there. Single addresses can have their own. {name}, {adresse} and {domain} are filled in per address.
settings.signaturesNoAddresses: Add a mailbox first, then you can write signatures.
settings.signatureOnServerDesc: Lives on your UwUMail server: the webmail, the portal and your other mail apps use the same one.
settings.signatureOnDeviceDesc: Stays on this device. Signatures of single addresses sync with your UwUMail account as before.
settings.signatureFromTemplate: This is your organisation's template. Change it and save it as your own.
settings.signatureFromAllDomains: This domain uses your signature for all domains.
settings.signatureCompanyFooter: When you send from this domain, the server adds this footer automatically:
settings.signatureDeviceFirst: In this app these addresses have signatures of their own. Here they go before the server's signature. Delete them if the server's should apply.
settings.signatureTooBig: The signature is getting too big. Use a smaller picture or fewer pictures.

attachment.noPreview: No preview for this file type
attachment.noPreviewBody: Open it with an app on your computer or save it.
attachment.pdfHint: Not showing up? Open it with your PDF app.
attachment.dangerTitle: This file can run programs on your computer
attachment.dangerBody: {{name}} comes from {{sender}}. Files like this are a common way to install malware. Only open it if you expected it and trust the sender.
attachment.notPdf: This file says it's a PDF but isn't one, so it isn't shown here. Save it or open it with an app if you trust it.
attachment.packageBlocked: UwUMail doesn't open app packages from mails. Save the file to Downloads if you expected it and trust the sender.
attachment.tnef: Outlook packed this mail and it couldn't be unpacked. For a UwUMail account, updating the server helps.

dangerous.body: This kind of file can run programs on your computer. Only open or save it if you expected it and trust the sender.

attachment.pdfNoPreview: This PDF can't be shown here. Open it with your PDF app or save it.

link.warningBody: The text shows a different address than where the link leads. Phishing mail often works like this.
link.confirmBody: Take a quick look at where it goes.
link.mailBody: The link starts a new mail to these recipients.
link.remember: Don't ask again for links to {{domain}}
link.remembered: Links to {{domain}} now open right away. You can change this in Settings under Reading.
link.insecure: Not encrypted (http): others can read what you enter on this page.
link.lookalike: The address mixes characters that look like others. Fake sites disguise themselves this way.
link.userinfo: There's a user name in front of the address that can look like another site. The real target is {{domain}}.
link.hiddenTarget: Where it goes after that isn't in the link.
link.safeLinkBody: Microsoft had wrapped this link in a scanner address. You see and open the real address instead.
link.unsupported: UwUMail doesn't open this kind of link.

dates.refineHint: The AI assistant reads this mail and finds appointments more precisely. May count toward your AI quota.
dates.refineFailed: The AI couldn't read it right now.
dates.weekdayMismatch: The weekday doesn't match the date.
dates.searching: The AI is looking for appointments…
dates.noneFound: No upcoming appointment found in this mail.

lock.title: UwUMail is locked
lock.body: Unlock with your fingerprint, face or your phone's PIN.

share.tooBig: {{names}} is too big for a mail and wasn't attached.

serverSearch.button: Also search older mail on the server
serverSearch.nothingMore: The server has no further matches.

move.title: Move to …
move.mixedAccounts: Mail from different mailboxes can only be moved one mailbox at a time.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from {{name}}?
unsubscribe.mailTo: That sends a mail from you to {{address}}.
unsubscribe.mailToFallback: If that doesn't work directly, a mail goes from you to {{address}}.
unsubscribe.body: UwUMail unsubscribes you with the sender directly. After that, no more mail should come from there.
unsubscribe.bodyPage: The sender has its own page for this. UwUMail opens it for you, and you confirm there.
unsubscribe.bodyOneClick: UwUMail asks the sender's server to take you off the list, in one step. After that, no more mail should come from there.
unsubscribe.orPage: If it can't be done that way, the sender's own page opens.
unsubscribe.failed: The sender's server didn't take it: {{reason}}
unsubscribe.failedNoReason: The sender's server didn't take it.
unsubscribe.tryMail: You can unsubscribe by mail instead. That sends a mail from you to {{address}}.
unsubscribe.tryPage: You can unsubscribe on the sender's own page instead.
unsubscribe.noOtherWay: This mail offers no other way. Try again later.

deleteForever.body_one: It's removed from the server too and can't be brought back.
deleteForever.body_other: They're removed from the server too and can't be brought back.

discardChanges.title: Discard your changes?
discardChanges.body: What you've entered here would be lost.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.settingDesc: Two workspaces, each with its own inbox. You only see the active workspace's mailboxes and mail, and switch with one click at the top.
workspace.setupBody: All others go to {{name}}. You can change this for each mailbox later.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: Part of UwUMail crashed while drawing. Reloading brings you back.

folders.name: Name
folders.deleteBody_one: Its {{count}} message moves to the trash.
folders.deleteBody_other: Its {{count}} messages move to the trash.
folders.hasChildrenBody: Delete or move the folders inside it first, then the folder itself.
folders.emptyBody_one: {{count}} message will be deleted for good, on the server too. This can't be undone.
folders.emptyBody_other: {{count}} messages will be deleted for good, on the server too. This can't be undone.
folders.alreadyEmpty: Nothing to delete, the folder is already empty

problem.control: The name contains invisible control characters.
problem.taken: There's already a folder with that name here.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.noneFound: None of your mailboxes has a calendar. You can enter a CalDAV address under Settings → Mailboxes.
calendar.noWritableCalendar: There's no calendar you can add events to.

repeat.label: Repeat
repeat.wholeSeries: Changes apply to every event of the series.
repeat.complex: This repetition was set up elsewhere and can't be changed here. It stays as it is.

problem.end: The end has to come after the start.
problem.repeat: Check the repetition: interval, days and end.
problem.name: Give the calendar a name.

calendar.deleteCalendarBody: All events in this calendar will be deleted too, on every device.

birthdays.hintBody: Move them into your contacts: the birthdays calendar then shows them with the age.
birthdays.title: Take over birthdays
birthdays.intro: These events look like birthdays. They go into your contacts, and the birthdays calendar shows them with the age from then on.
birthdays.none: No birthday events found in your calendars.
birthdays.truncated: There are more than fit at once. Take these over, then look again.
birthdays.keeps: The event stays (its calendar is read-only)
birthdays.deleteWarning_one: Afterwards {{count}} original event is deleted from its calendar. Nothing is deleted where taking over fails.
birthdays.deleteWarning_other: Afterwards the {{count}} original events are deleted from their calendars. Nothing is deleted where taking over fails.
birthdays.partly: {{done}} taken over, {{failed}} not. Their events are still there.

rules.title: Mail rules
rules.description: Your server sorts arriving mail with these rules, from top to bottom, even while UwUMail is closed. UwUMail on the web shows the same rules.
rules.empty: No rules yet. With a rule, mail from a sender can go straight into a folder, for example.
rules.invalid: The server doesn't accept these rules: {{reason}}
rules.inactive: These rules are switched off on the server right now.
rules.otherActive: Another filter script, “{{name}}”, sorts your mail on the server right now. Saving rules here switches it off.
rules.otherActiveUnnamed: Another filter script sorts your mail on the server right now. Saving rules here switches it off.
rules.name: Name
rules.keepCopy: Keep a copy here as well
rules.forwardHint: Works for addresses on this server and for addresses you confirmed under forwarding in your UwUMail portal. Otherwise the mail simply stays here.
rules.stopDesc: Rules further down don't run for mail this rule caught.

problem.emptyValue: Enter the text to look for.
problem.badAddress: Enter one complete address, like name@example.com.
problem.tooMany: One folder and one forward per rule.

rules.foreignBody: Another program changed the rules script, so UwUMail shows it as text. You can edit it here, or replace it with rules you manage in UwUMail.
rules.replaceBody: The script above will be deleted and you start with an empty list of rules.

accountCalendar.title: Calendar
accountCalendar.urlHint: Only needed when UwUMail doesn't find the calendars by itself.

problem.https: The address has to start with https://.

accountCalendar.cleared: Address removed. UwUMail looks for the calendars by itself again.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.deleteBookBody_one: The {{count}} contact in it will be deleted on every device.
contacts.deleteBookBody_other: The {{count}} contacts in it will be deleted on every device.

empty.title: No contacts yet
empty.body: Add contacts here or save senders from your mail.

contacts.pick: Pick a contact on the left.
contacts.groupReadOnly: This is a group. Groups can only be viewed here.
contacts.deleteBody: The contact will be deleted on every device that syncs this address book.

problem.name: Enter a name, a company or an email address.
problem.bookName: Give the address book a name.

contacts.bookReadOnly: This address book can only be viewed.
contacts.noneFound: None of your mailboxes has an address book. You can enter a CardDAV address under Settings → Mailboxes.
contacts.remindersHint: They ring on every device with the birthdays calendar.

accountContacts.title: Contacts
accountContacts.urlHint: Only needed when UwUMail doesn't find the address books by itself.
accountContacts.cleared: Address removed. UwUMail looks for the address books by itself again.

cloudSignIn.hint: Sign in again to see calendar and contacts. Mail keeps working either way.
cloudSignIn.hintFor: Sign in to {{name}} again to see its calendar and contacts.
cloudSignIn.adminConsent: Your organisation lets apps use these permissions only after an administrator agrees. Ask them to allow UwUMail again; your mail keeps working in the meantime.

error.unavailable: The assistant can't do that right now. Your administrator switched it off, or no model may be used for it.
error.overQuota: Today's limit for the assistant is used up. It resets at midnight (UTC).
error.providerFailed: The model didn't give a usable answer. Try again in a moment.
error.busy: The model is busy right now. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
error.notFound: That mail isn't there any more.
error.forbidden: The assistant only works on your own mail.
error.invalid: The assistant didn't accept that request.
error.connection: The mail server or the provider can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to use the assistant.
error.generic: Something went wrong with the assistant.
error.consent: Nothing was sent: sending this mail to the AI provider isn't allowed yet.

compose.scopeNew: Describe what the mail should say. Nothing goes into your draft until you insert it.
compose.scopeReply: The mail you're answering is used as context. Nothing goes into your draft until you insert it.
compose.scopeSelection: Works on the text you marked.
compose.scopeOwn: Works on your own text, without signature and quoted mail.
compose.nothingToRewrite: There's no text to work on yet. Write something first, or mark a passage.
compose.tooLong_one: The text is too long for the assistant (at most {{count}} character). Mark a shorter passage.
compose.tooLong_other: The text is too long for the assistant (at most {{count}} characters). Mark a shorter passage.
compose.writePlaceholder: e.g. Invite the team to a short meeting on Friday at 10
compose.replyPlaceholder: e.g. Say yes, but ask to move it to Thursday
compose.adjustPlaceholder: e.g. Mention the attachment and end with a question
compose.replaceOwnHint: Replaces your own text; signature and quoted mail stay
compose.reviewNote: Written by an AI model: read it before you send it.

spam.title: Spam check
spam.decide: You decide. The model only gives a second opinion.

verdictHint.legitimate: Nothing points to spam or fraud.
verdictHint.suspicious: Some things are odd. Be careful with links and attachments.
verdictHint.spam: Most likely unwanted advertising or mass mail.
verdictHint.phishing: Likely an attempt to get your password, money or data. Don't click links or open attachments.

spam.modelVerdict: The model said “{{verdict}}”, but the facts don’t allow that, so the verdict stays within what they support.
spam.modelWordsHint: These reasons were written by the model itself and not checked by anyone. Rely on the checked facts.
spam.authNone: Not checked: the mail didn't come from another server.
spam.scoreNone: The spam filter didn't look at this mail.
spam.earlierWithJunk_one: {{count}} earlier mail, {{junk}} of them in spam
spam.earlierWithJunk_other: {{count}} earlier mails, {{junk}} of them in spam
spam.neverWritten: You've never written to this address
spam.dropped_one: {{count}} reason of the model was left out because nothing in the mail backs it.
spam.dropped_other: {{count}} reasons of the model were left out because nothing in the mail backs them.

evidence.FILTER_WANTED: The spam filter found nothing worrying
evidence.FILTER_SOME_POINTS: Some points from the spam filter
evidence.DMARC_PASS: DMARC passed: really from this domain
evidence.DMARC_FAIL: DMARC failed: the sender may be forged
evidence.WRITTEN_TO: You wrote to this sender before
evidence.EARLIER_IN_JUNK: Earlier mail from this sender ended up in Junk
evidence.PAYMENT_REQUEST: Asks for money or payment data
evidence.LOOKALIKE_BRAND_FROM: Sender domain imitates a known brand
evidence.BRAND_IN_FROM_DOMAIN: Sender domain carries a brand name
evidence.LOOKALIKE_CONTACT_FROM: Sender domain imitates one of your contacts
evidence.FROM_NAME_SPOOFS_ADDRESS: Display name shows a different address
evidence.FROM_NAME_SHOWS_DOMAIN: Display name shows a different domain
evidence.BRAND_IN_FROM_NAME: Brand name in the display name, sent from elsewhere
evidence.REPLY_TO_OTHER_SITE: Replies go to a different site
evidence.BRAND_LINK_TEXT: Link text names a brand, the link goes elsewhere
evidence.TRACKED_LINK_TEXT: Link text and target differ (tracking link)
evidence.PHISHING_LINK_TEXT: Link text shows a different address than the target
evidence.BRAND_IN_SUBJECT: Brand name in the subject with a warning
evidence.CREDENTIAL_REQUEST: Asks for login details off the brand’s own site
evidence.LINK_TO_IP: Link to a bare IP address
evidence.HTML_ATTACHMENT: HTML attachment (often a fake login page)
evidence.MALWARE_LINK: Link to a known malware site
evidence.SPAMHAUS_DBL_MALICIOUS: Link to a domain listed as malicious

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Your own words for kinds of mail. Labels show up on mail here and in other mail apps (as keywords). The model only ever picks among your labels; it never moves, deletes or answers mail.
labels.descriptionManual: Your own words for kinds of mail, set by hand from the reader. They show up in other mail apps too (as keywords).
labels.autoDesc: Incoming mail gets the one label that fits best, sometimes a second one, and none when the model isn't sure. For that the model reads your labels' names and descriptions and the start of each mail.
labels.autoNoLabels: Add a few labels first; then incoming mail gets the ones that fit.
labels.noProvider: No model may set labels at the moment, so nothing is labelled.
labels.name: Name
labels.descriptionHint: The model reads this to decide. A few words or examples are enough.
labels.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Flights, hotels and train tickets
labels.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? It comes off every mail that has it.
labels.full_one: You've reached the limit of {{count}} label.
labels.full_other: You've reached the limit of {{count}} labels.
labels.applyDesc_one: Mail that came before the labels were on stays as it is. Let the model look at your newest inbox mail now.
labels.applyDesc_other: Mail that came before the labels were on stays as it is. Let the model look at your {{count}} newest inbox mails now.
labels.appliedNone: None of the recent mails fit your labels

problem.nameTaken: You already have a label with that name.
problem.control: Line breaks and control characters don't work here.

settings.title: AI assistant
settings.description: Help with writing, summaries, a second opinion on spam and labels for your mail. Only the text a feature needs is sent to the model, never attachments.
settings.noneBody: Your administrator hasn't allowed any model for you yet, or none is reachable. Once one is, the assistant's features show up here and in the mail.
settings.choiceDescription: One provider for everything, and your own choice per feature where you want one.
settings.refineEvents: Look for appointments whenever a mail opens
settings.refineEventsDesc: The model reads every mail you open for dates, which counts towards your daily limit. Off: only when you ask.
settings.deviceDescription: The providers set up here, for every mailbox without an assistant on its server. Keys stay in the system keychain; mail goes straight from this device to the provider.
settings.serverDescription: The assistant of this UwUMail account’s server.
settings.deviceNoneBody: Add a provider below, such as your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Mistral key, or a local model with Ollama.
settings.currencyHint: AI costs are shown in this currency, converted with the ECB reference rates.

serverAssist.title: AI from your UwUMail server
serverAssist.use: Use a UwUMail server's AI for these mailboxes
serverAssist.useOne: Use the AI of {{server}} for these mailboxes
serverAssist.description: Summaries, spam checks, appointments and labels for your other mailboxes then come from that server instead of the providers set up here. The mail's content (sender, subject and text) is sent to that server for this.
serverAssist.sentTitle: Mail of your other mailboxes goes to {{server}} for the AI
serverAssist.sentBody: Only when the AI is asked, and only what it needs. That server's providers, limits and usage apply; the providers set up here are not used for these mailboxes while this is on.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Where the models come from: those your server offers, and your own with your own key.
providers.full_one: You've reached the limit of {{count}} provider of your own.
providers.full_other: You've reached the limit of {{count}} providers of your own.
providers.noOwn: Your administrator doesn't allow providers of your own; you can use the server's.
providers.confirmDelete: Delete this provider and its stored key? Features that use it switch to the next one.
providers.name: Name
providers.baseUrlHintLan: Where it's reached, e.g. Ollama in your network. Plain http:// only works inside the local network.
providers.baseUrlHintNoLan: Where the server reaches it over the internet, with https://. Addresses in the local network aren't allowed on this server.
providers.insecure: An http:// address outside the local network would send your key unencrypted, so it's refused. Use https://.
providers.keyOptional: API key (if the server needs one)
providers.keyHint: Stored encrypted (on the mail server, or in this device's keychain) and never shown again.
providers.keyKeep: Stored: {{hint}}. Leave empty to keep it.
providers.anthropicNote: Only with an API key from the Anthropic Console. A Claude subscription (Pro or Max) can't be used here.
providers.fastModelHint: Cheaper and quicker, for summaries, spam checks, appointments and labels.
providers.privacy: Mail text is sent to this provider when you use the assistant. Check how the provider treats your data.

problem.urlMissing: The address is needed for this provider.
problem.urlScheme: The address has to start with http:// or https://.
problem.urlLogin: Leave user name and password out of the address.
problem.keyMissing: This provider needs an API key.

providers.modelsFailed: The provider didn't list its models. You can still type one.
providers.modelsNone: No models found. You can still type one.
providers.priceHint: Empty uses the known price of the model.

chatgpt.warning: This signs in with your ChatGPT subscription the way OpenAI's Codex CLI does. OpenAI doesn't offer it for other apps: it can stop working at any time, counts against your ChatGPT limits, and using it may be against OpenAI's terms. An API key is the reliable way.
chatgpt.steps: Open the OpenAI page, sign in with your ChatGPT account and enter this code:
chatgpt.expired: The code ran out. Start again.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: What the assistant used for you. Days count in UTC.
usage.limitReached: Today's limit is reached. It resets at midnight (UTC).

local.title: Found on this computer
local.description: A local AI is running here. Add it with one click, and your mail never leaves this computer for it.

labelAgain.title: Label again
labelAgain.decide: Nothing changes until you apply. Your ticks also teach the automatic labels.

consent.title: Send this mail to {{name}}?
consent.intro: For this, the AI assistant sends personal data from your mail to {{name}} ({{host}}). Nothing has been sent yet.
consent.introServer: For this, the AI assistant sends personal data from your mail to the UwUMail server of {{name}} ({{host}}). That server passes it on to the AI provider its administrator chose. Nothing has been sent yet.

sent.people: Names and addresses of the sender and recipients
sent.subject: The subject
sent.draft: What you write in your draft, and the mail you reply to
sent.headers: Technical headers of the mail, such as its sign-in checks (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and links
sent.pictures: Text read from the mail's pictures
sent.labels: The names and descriptions of your labels

consent.purpose: Used only to answer what you ask for: {{features}}.
consent.terms: The privacy policy and terms of {{name}} apply to what is sent there.
consent.termsServer: The privacy terms of that server and of its AI provider apply to what is sent there.
consent.revoke: You can take this back at any time in Settings → AI assistant.

settings.title: Data sharing
settings.description: Where you allowed the assistant to send your mail. Once you take it back, nothing more goes there until you allow it again. A model on this computer needs no permission.
settings.none: You haven't allowed sending mail anywhere yet.

labels.title: Labels

quick.title: Labels
quick.for_one: For {{count}} conversation. Enter or a click puts a label on or takes it off.
quick.for_other: For {{count}} conversations. Enter or a click puts a label on or takes it off.
quick.none: No labels yet. Type a name to create one.

settings.title: Labels
settings.intro: Your own words for kinds of mail, shown in the list and in other mail apps (as keywords). They go on new mail by their rules, detectors and what they learned from you, without any AI; the assistant can add more if you switch it on.
settings.deviceDesc: Labels of every mailbox that isn't a UwUMail account. They stay on this device and are set here.
settings.serverDesc: Kept on your UwUMail server and set there, also while this app is closed.
settings.description: New mail gets labels by their rules, detectors and learning first; the model helps where those aren't sure. A mail gets at most two labels, and none when it's unclear. It never moves, deletes or answers a mail.
settings.descriptionManual: New mail gets labels by their rules, detectors and learning. You can also put them on by hand in the reader, with a right-click in the list or with L.
settings.nonAiDesc: Rules, detectors, learned senders and the classifier put labels on new mail. Nothing leaves this device or your server for it.
settings.automaticTitle: Put it on new mail by itself
settings.automaticDesc: The first of these that matches puts the label on; no AI needed.
settings.detectorHint: Built-in recognition of common kinds of mail.

problem.control: Line breaks and control characters can't be used.

settings.learnSendersDesc: A sender whose mail you gave this label by hand twice gets it on new mail. Taking it off forgets the sender.
settings.classifierDesc: Once it knows 15 mails you labeled by hand, very similar new mail gets the label. So far: {{count}} of {{needed}}.
settings.listDescription: Name, colour and what puts each label on mail by itself.
settings.autoLabelDesc: Off: the label only goes on when you put it on by hand. Nothing sets it by itself then, not its conditions, the detector, learned senders, similar mails or the assistant.

source.similar: Like your mails with this label

reason.subject: subject contains “{{value}}”
reason.sender_one: {{address}} got this label by hand once
reason.sender_other: {{address}} got this label by hand {{count}} times
reason.invoiceAttachment: Looks like an invoice: PDF attachment “{{name}}”
reason.invoiceAmount: Looks like an invoice: “{{word}}” in the subject, {{amount}}
reason.invoiceWord: Looks like an invoice: “{{word}}” in the subject
reason.appointmentCalendar: Looks like an appointment: a calendar invitation
reason.appointment: Looks like an appointment: “{{word}}” on {{date}} at {{time}}
reason.newsletter: Looks like a newsletter: it has List-Unsubscribe and {{header}}
reason.classifier_one: Similar to the mail with this label ({{percent, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} % sure)
reason.classifier_other: Similar to the {{count}} mails with this label ({{percent, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} % sure)
reason.similar: Like {{count}} of your mails with this label ({{percent}} % alike)
reason.invoiceNumber: Looks like an invoice: invoice number {{number}}, {{amount}}
reason.accountCode: About your account: a one-time code
reason.personalKnown: Looks personal: written by a person you know
reason.personalPrivate: Looks personal: written by a person from a private address
reason.workColleague: Looks like work: written by a colleague from your own domain
reason.workContact: Looks like work: written by a business contact you know

log.title: Set lately
log.description: Labels that went on by themselves, and why. Undo takes one off and teaches the label.

base.title: Base labels
base.description: Eight fixed labels, each with a sharp definition, so mail gets the same label every time. Rename them or change their colour as you like, and choose for each one whether it goes on by itself.
base.previousHint: This is how you described the label before the base label took it over. The model still gets it as a hint next to the base label's definition, and the definition decides. Forget it to stop sending it.
base.previousForgotten: The earlier description is no longer sent.
base.usePrevious: Use it for a new label
base.missingDescription: Bring a base label back with its definition. Mail it was on before doesn't get it back.
base.fixedDefinition: A base label's definition is fixed: labelling goes by it, by hand and by itself.
base.detectorBuiltIn: Has its own detector built in.

overlap.title: Overlaps with your labels
overlap.name: “{{name}}” already has this name.
overlap.meaning: Means the same as the base label “{{name}}”.
overlap.hint: You can still save it, but mail might then get the wrong one of the two.

labels.pickerEmpty: No labels yet. Type a name to create one.

shared.title: Shared mailboxes
shared.addIntro: A shared mailbox opens with the sign-in of {{email}}. Enter its address; UwUMail checks that you have access.
shared.noAccess: {{account}} can't open {{email}}. Is it a shared mailbox you have full access to?
shared.statePending: UwUMail looks for your shared mailboxes shortly.
shared.stateDone: Shared mailboxes you have access to are added automatically.
shared.stateNeedsSignIn: Sign in again to find shared mailboxes automatically.
shared.stateUnavailable: Microsoft didn't say which shared mailboxes you have. You can still add them by address.
shared.removeConfirm: Remove the shared mailbox {{email}}? It isn't added again automatically; you can add it by address any time. Mail on the server isn't touched.
shared.toggle: Show or hide the shared mailboxes of {{email}}

scheduled.title: Scheduled mail
scheduled.desc: Your UwUMail server sends mail from its mailboxes at the time you chose, also while UwUMail is closed. Everything else waits on this device and goes out if UwUMail is running at that time, otherwise the next time it starts.
scheduled.empty: Nothing is waiting to be sent.
scheduled.stopped: Not sent. The mail is back in Drafts.
scheduled.sentNow: The mail is going out now.
scheduled.heldFailed: Not sent: {{reason}} It waits here until you send it again, change its time, edit it or stop it.
scheduled.heldUnsure: May have gone out: {{reason}} It won't be sent again unless you choose to.

masked.title: Masked addresses
masked.description: A masked address is a random address for one website. Mail to it arrives here, but the site never learns your real address. If one starts getting spam, you know who passed it on and switch it off. Password managers can make them for you too.
masked.closedTitle: Masked addresses aren't enabled for you
masked.closedBody: Your administrator hasn't enabled new masked addresses for your account. The ones you already have keep working and stay manageable here.
masked.copyFailed: The address couldn't be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.

hint.url: Where you use it, for example your account page or a password manager entry.
hint.prefix: Goes in front of the random part, like shop.maple.otter482@…

problem.control: Line breaks and control characters don't work here.
problem.prefix: Only lower-case letters a–z, digits and _, at most {{max}} characters.

masked.loadFailed: The masked addresses couldn't be loaded. {{reason}}
masked.empty: No masked addresses yet. Make one for the next site you sign up to.
masked.noMatch: No masked address matches your search.
masked.pending: Waiting for its first mail. Without one within 24 hours it is deleted.
masked.deleted: {{email}} deleted. Mail to it is refused now.

error.forbidden: This address can't be made: the domain isn't allowed for you, or you've reached the limit of masked addresses.
error.invalid: The server didn't accept these details. Check the fields and try again.
error.notFound: This masked address is gone. The list has been refreshed.
error.connection: The server can't be reached. Try again in a moment.
error.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

crop.title: Crop picture
crop.hint: Drag to move it, scroll or pinch to zoom. Keyboard: arrow keys move, + and − zoom.

error.tooLarge: That picture is too big. Up to {{size}} works.

picture.hint: Or drop a picture on the circle, or paste one.

profile.pictureDesc: It shows next to your name wherever people may see it. Choose a picture and place it in the circle.

server.title: People on this server
server.body: Everyone with a mailbox here sees it next to your mails.

public.title: Everyone
public.body: Other mail servers and apps can show it too, through Libravatar. Anyone who knows your address can look it up.

profile.publicForbidden: Your admin switched public pictures off.
profile.faceDesc: Puts a small copy into every mail you send (the Face header), which some mail programs show. Only while your picture is public.

sharing.notAllowed: The owner of this folder didn't allow that.
sharing.title: Share “{{name}}”
sharing.search: Name or address of somebody on this server
sharing.peopleFailed: The people on this server couldn't be loaded.
sharing.leaveCalendarBody: The calendar stays {{name}}'s. You only stop seeing it, until they share it again.

levelsDesc.calendar: Read: see the calendar and its events. Read and write: also add, change and delete events. Everything: also rename it, change its colour and share it on.

invitation.title: Invitation

answered.tentative: Answered maybe. The organizer is told.

unverified.invitation: This invitation doesn't come from the event's organizer, so it can't be answered from here. If you know the event, answer it in your calendar.
unverified.cancel: This mail says the event is cancelled, but nothing confirms it comes from the event's organizer. Your calendar keeps the event as it is.
unverified.reply: This answer doesn't come from anyone invited to the event, so it doesn't count.

invitation.occurrence: This mail is about one date only: {{date}}
invitation.update: The organizer changed this event. Your answer goes with the new version.
invitation.outdated: Your calendar already has a newer version of this event, so this mail can't be answered any more.
invitation.senderUnconfirmed: The receiving mail server didn't confirm the sender's address. Only answer if you expected this invitation.

place.server: Your UwUMail server tells the organizer.
place.calendar: UwUMail puts the event into your calendar and tells the organizer by mail.
place.device: UwUMail keeps the event in the calendar “Invitations” on this device and tells the organizer by mail.

push.showContentDesc: When this is off, a notification about new mail only says that new mail came. With the app lock on, it never says more.

uwumailSignIn.hint: The server doesn’t let {{name}} in any more. Sign in again with UwUMail and this device gets a fresh app password.
